card1: IQR rule: 1.5×IQR fence is binary — fires the same on 0.1 past the fence as on 100 past it. Most assumption-light outlier rule, but loses magnitude information.
card2: Z-score rule: assumes Gaussian data, but sales is log-normal and latency is exponential. The rule inflates its own threshold when real outliers appear, becoming blind to signal.
card3: Modified Z-score: replaces mean and standard deviation with median and MAD (median absolute deviation). Scale correction 0.6745, threshold 3.5. Stable when real outliers enter the data.
